text:
simon_customer: Hey team — we're seeing a bunch of users in org `acme-llm` getting kicked back to the MFA prompt every ~10s after SSO. They can log in, complete MFA, redirect back to the app, then immediately get `session_expired` and forced to reauth. Happens on Chrome desktop only (Mac). Mobile + Firefox are fine.

elaine_support: hi @simon_customer — sorry about that. Can you paste 1) a sample request_id from the failed flow, 2) the user_id/email, and 3) whether incognito + clearing cookies changed anything? Also which browser version? :mag:

simon_customer: request_id=01GZ3K2Q8Y2A9T7X1BZX, user=simon@acme.com. Tried incognito & cleared cookies — no change on Chrome 112.0.5615. Logs show `auth: session_expired` at redirect. Interestingly, if the user goes to mobile it works (same account). I grabbed a couple headers from the redirect: 

Cookie: rwd_session=eyJhbGci...; rwd_device_trust=; other=...
Set-Cookie: rwd_session=...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly
Set-Cookie: rwd_device_trust=1; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; Secure

But in Chrome devtools during the redirect the `rwd_device_trust` cookie sometimes isn't present.

elaine_support: thanks — can you also give the exact timestamp when this occurred (UTC) so SRE can correlate?

simon_customer: sure: 2025-11-09T15:12:44Z (approx).

session-bot: Automated note — rotating session tokens: user simon@acme.com token-rotated at 2025-11-09T15:12:43Z (trace=01GZ3K2Q8Y2A9T7X1BZX).

marta_sre: looking now. I can see repeated 401s for that trace. Snippet from runtime logs around that time: 
```
2025-11-09T15:12:43.125Z INFO auth request_id=01GZ3K2Q8Y2A9T7X1BZX user=simon@acme.com action=redirect_to_sp status=200
2025-11-09T15:12:44.978Z WARN auth request_id=01GZ3K2Q8Y2A9T7X1BZX user=simon@acme.com action=validate_session status=401 reason=session_expired cookie_present=false
2025-11-09T15:12:45.012Z INFO auth request_id=01GZ3K2Q8Y2A9T7X1BZX user=simon@acme.com action=initiate_reauth status=302
```

marta_sre: note `cookie_present=false` — runtime is not seeing the device trust cookie on the POST callback that should preserve the session.

raj_idm: fwiw the IdP (Okta) assertion for that flow shows the assertion is valid and the SAML session is still active. My initial hunch: the device-trust cookie is being set with SameSite=Lax during a POST redirect chain, and Chrome is dropping it on cross-site -> site-to-site POST redirect. We changed a cookie helper in last week's runtime PR that defaulted SameSite to Lax. That would explain desktop Chrome only.

nina_devex: repro steps I used locally to simulate: 1) start `ngrok` to expose local callback, 2) kick SSO flow, 3) complete MFA on idp, 4) observe final redirect POST to `/auth/callback`. With `curl -v` the `Set-Cookie: rwd_device_trust=1; SameSite=Lax` header is present but browser does not send it back on the next request (chrome). Reproduced consistently with Chrome 112.

simon_customer: confirmed I can reproduce with `curl -i` showing Set-Cookie present but when Chrome follows the redirect the cookie is absent in the outgoing request. Noted that if I change SameSite=None locally the cookie is sent and session persists.

elaine_support: ok — sounds like a regression from the cookie helper. For now: a workaround for affected users is to do a full logout -> login from the same tab (not cross-site) or use mobile. We can also ask them to enable third-party cookies but that's not ideal.

marta_sre: next steps from infra side: 1) back out the cookie helper change in canary -> verify, 2) add an e2e test that simulates SSO redirect chains with Chrome user-agent, 3) patch runtime to set `SameSite=None; Secure; HttpOnly; Domain=.redwood.com` for device-trust cookie. I can open the rollback PR.

raj_idm: also check clock skew between IdP and runtime — but logs show assertion timestamps ok. Another subtle gotcha: if the cookie `Domain` doesn't match (e.g., set to `localhost` or omit leading dot) Chrome won't send it on cross-site redirects. Make sure domain is root-level and path=/ so subpaths are covered.

nina_devex: here's a quick curl snippet for eng to reproduce: 
```
# reproduce redirect chain
curl -v -c cookies.txt 'https://idp.example.com/sso/start?sp=https://ngrok.io/auth/callback' \ 
  -L
# then inspect cookies.txt for rwd_device_trust
cat cookies.txt
```

elaine_support: simon — I've opened INC-2025-1936 for tracking, and escalated to eng-runtime with high priority. I'll DM the customer with the workaround (logout+login or mobile) and ETA for rollback. :+1: 

marta_sre: created rollback PR #4872 (revert f3c2d9c) and started a canary deploy to `canary-rt-2`. I'll monitor and post results here.

session-bot: Canary deploy complete on canary-rt-2 at 2025-11-09T16:03:10Z (deploy=canary-rt-2, pr=4872).

marta_sre: canary looks good — I hit the same flow with Chrome and device-trust cookie is now sent. No 401s in the trace. Rolling to prod in 10m unless objections.

raj_idm: please ensure we add regression tests in the SSO suite and update cookie helper docs.

elaine_support: thanks all — I messaged the customer with the fix and will close INC once prod rollout is finished. Will follow up if any lingering sessions need manual revocation. :white_check_mark:

simon_customer: thanks team! huge help. Will confirm with the affected users after rollout.

marta_sre: follow-up task: ENG-RT add e2e: sso_cookie_same_site_chrome, and ENG-SEC to review cookie flags. I'll file both tickets.

nina_devex: added notes to the troubleshooting guide section "SSO redirect cookie drops (Chrome)" with the workaround and a debugging checklist (request_id, cookie headers, reproduce with curl).

elaine_support: closing loop here but keeping thread open for any post-rollout regressions. :eyes:
